kind: baseline storey-registration forensics at the starting code a70047fc131f048138f88ee1fc569fbf8b0fd009, before any production change: the structural pass (composeStructuralLayout) on each development row’s sealed package, observation graph and metric evidence (research/analyzer-005l/storey-trace.ts), and the synthetic attached-wing fixture (layout.test.ts fixture B). Numbers, ids and rectangles only; no source pixel.

fields.alignmentCandidates: every distinct placement alignPlans weighed: target, scale, offsets, agreement, coverage prior (back-computed from the score), stated, score
fields.supportByLowerMass: per lower mass: the mapped envelope’s intersection (m²), as a share of the lower mass and of the upper envelope, whether the current >= 0.5 rule holds, the same per mapped upper BUILT region, and the mass’s storey span and footprint regions as the pass left them

A06.why: The attic plan (853 px copy) prints no chain, so it has no registration and no stated scale. Its long-band envelope runs from the walls (x 133.5..470.5) to the publisher mark at the sheet foot (x to 793, y to 778): 659.5 × 596.5 px against walls of 337 × 531 px. The rectangle fitted to each of the three targets is then 1.5–2.4× anisotropic, over the 1.15 gate, and no candidate is generated at all. The plan is never registered; no mass reaches storey 1; NO_MASS_REACHES_UP. Downstream, had it registered, support was the mapped envelope covering >= 50 % of a lower mass and v2 emission copies every storey from the mass rectangle (both latent).

A07.why: The upper plan (853 px) prints no chain: no registration, no stated scale. Its envelope (67..819.5 × 202.5..757) takes in the publisher mark below the plan (three BUILT "regions" of 0.9–1.2 m² at y 723–757); the walls are 67..786 × 202.5..520. Fitted onto the 743.5 × 337 px ground envelope the rectangle is 1.63× anisotropic on every target: zero candidates, never registered, NO_MASS_REACHES_UP. Same latent defects as A06.

A01.why: The attic plan prints no chain. Its envelope and its only BUILT region are the eave line drawn as a dark band above and below the walls (y 89.5..545 against walls at about 120..530), and the band survey takes the eave band as the wall thickness (28 px against 11 below). The rectangle fitted to the envelope target is 1.21× anisotropic, and to every other target more: zero candidates. Even registered, the walled region is the eave outline, not the knee walls (UPPER_BUILT_REGION). The run then stops later at FILL_TOO_LARGE (placeWindow), which 005L does not touch.

D00.why: The attic plan (DobreDomy, 1351 × 1856) prints no chain and draws the roof planes round the attic; the envelope is the roof outline, and its BUILT regions include roof planes. Zero candidates: never registered. The ground plan decomposition independently misses the garage and takes in the round terrace (the footprint co-failure); that is not a storey decision and is not tuned here.

A03.why: Known-good by the verdict, wrong in fact: the attic envelope takes in the publisher mark, and the rectangle fitted to it puts the attic at 0.698 of its true size (walls at 7.0 × 7.9 m against a 9.1 × 12.0 m house). It still stacks because the MAPPED ENVELOPE (mark included) covers 97 % of the body, and the emitted upper storey is the ground ring copied, so the error never reaches the model.

dom-w-jablonkach.why: Known-good by the verdict, stacked by accident: the chosen placement is the stated scale 1.404 (the attic registration reads 0.0297 m/px against 0.0212 below) with 16 % agreement, coverage prior 0 and a margin of 0 to four tied placements; its mapped envelope (217.7 m², reaching 4 m outside the house) covers 92 % of the body, and the ground ring is copied upstairs.

marcowki.why: Registered correctly by the fitted rectangle onto the main body (1.020, 60 % agreement, margin 0.27); the garage stays one storey. The upper storey footprint recorded is the mapped envelope ∩ body, and the emitter ignores it and copies the ground ring.

dom-w-zurawkach.why: Basement and attic plans print no chain; both envelopes take in sheet furniture; zero candidates for either. The verdict counts three labelled plan storeys.

dom-w-gozdzikowcach.why: The attic plan prints no chain; its envelope (113.5..684) takes in roof and sheet ink beyond the walls; zero candidates. The house is refused earlier by its footprint in any case.
